method: current public service pages plus dated internal service quotes

services.access_mechanics: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider token gateway; 50 free requests/day basic tier; model endpoints have separate capability and pricing metadata.
services.price_or_billing: USD/model/provider token billing; quoted models and funding fees separate
services.quota_notes: Shared free tier request limits and quotas; models/routes volatile
services.risks: Beware ZDR/prompt logging and request routing changes.

services.access_mechanics: Direct OpenAI-compatible API exposing community/abliterated models. API credits and consumer subscription entitlements must not be conflated.
services.price_or_billing: Pay per token; separate Pro subscription benefits may differ
services.quota_notes: Per-model limits and privacy tier, check zero-retention and anonymized flags
services.risks: Low refusal is a training characteristic, not an authorization exemption.

services.access_mechanics: Token Plan sells 5h/week allocations for listed coding tools, with concurrent agent bands; separate direct PAYG M2.7/M3 endpoint.
services.price_or_billing: Plus ~$20, Max ~$50, Ultra ~$120 monthly, latest cart check required; PAYG rate independent
services.quota_notes: Provider-described M3-equivalent tokens are estimates, not transferable API credits
services.risks: Do not run unattended farms on interactive seat allowances.

services.access_mechanics: Coding plan uses credits with model-specific multipliers and 5-hour/week reset; direct model API priced separately.
services.price_or_billing: Lite ~$18, Pro ~$80, Max ~$168; verify current checkout
services.quota_notes: Lite 2k/5h 10k/week; Pro 12k/5h 60k/week; Max 28k/5h 140k/week
services.risks: Aliases may redirect GLM name/version; record actual resolved endpoint.

services.access_mechanics: Kimi Code API key for eligible third-party interactive coding clients; generic Moonshot developer API separate.
services.price_or_billing: Membership tiers $19/$39/$99/$199 published; separate API payg
services.quota_notes: Shared monthly and rolling coding usage windows
services.risks: Do not reuse membership login cookies as backend API credentials.

services.access_mechanics: Plus and Pro quota discounts; daily allowance then payg; variable ceilings.
services.price_or_billing: Plus $10/month, Pro $20/month published in prior snapshot
services.quota_notes: Short-window 5x-equivalent consumption ceiling may apply
services.risks: Do not advertise unlimited throughput.

services.access_mechanics: Chat $25 is human-only; Developer $50 provides $50 prepaid credits for agent-eligible metered usage.
services.price_or_billing: Developer prepaid balance, not included unlimited inference
services.quota_notes: Chat automated agents and benchmarks forbidden; Developer usage metered
services.risks: Provider model library broad, but context/tool capability vary.

services.access_mechanics: $50 coding subscription for supported third-party coding tools, explicit non-interactive backend/script prohibition.
services.price_or_billing: $50/month coding; separate Model Studio token PAYG
services.quota_notes: 6k/5h; 45k/wk; 90k/mo published
services.risks: Fail closed on automated backend access.

services.access_mechanics: Prepaid/payg serverless model APIs, cached token pricing, dedicated inference or provisioned-throughput PTUs.
services.price_or_billing: Per 1M tokens; dedicated PTUs/instances separate
services.quota_notes: Scale/concurrency limited by account and serverless model quota
services.risks: Use their exact live model id; display names insufficient.

services.access_mechanics: Prepaid credit serverless; standard/priority/fast serving; on-demand GPU deployments and LoRA/full tuning.
services.price_or_billing: Token PAYG; H100 on-demand $8/GPU-hour quoted; training has distinct rates
services.quota_notes: Different service tiers, serverless limits; auto-reload optional
services.risks: Watch disabled default auto topups; monthly cap requires explicit consent.

services.access_mechanics: Developer $5 promotional credits after payment method, API PAYG, Enterprise production contract.
services.quota_notes: Free $5 expires 30 days; Developer tier is evaluation-only
services.risks: Reported 3000 t/s for gpt-oss is marketing throughput, not Agent OS verified.

services.access_mechanics: OpenAI/AI SDK compatible routing; charges per request/tokens; optional workspace roles/spend limits/BYOK.
services.quota_notes: Listed some free experimental models, provider may change availability
services.risks: Auto-reload policy must be read carefully; enforce separate user-side cap.

services.access_mechanics: Fast hosted text/audio inference APIs, published developer pricing and quotas.
services.price_or_billing: model-dependent, not quoted in this pass
services.quota_notes: Model availability and max context vary
services.risks: Unverified price until exact model page fetch.

services.access_mechanics: Per-model API for serverless inference; separate dedicated GPUs as offered.
services.price_or_billing: model-dependent, not quoted in this pass
services.quota_notes: Model/tool support and batching vary
services.risks: Do not assume free trial is current.

services.access_mechanics: Deploy open weights on GPUs, autoscaling/private models, meter inference GPU runtime.
services.price_or_billing: compute-dependent; no uniform token rate
services.quota_notes: Cold start/scale-to-zero availability and minimum memory footprint
services.risks: Better suited custom weights needing specific kernels.

services.access_mechanics: Deploy code/container/model server on GPU billed by active resources plus CPU/RAM/storage.
services.price_or_billing: GPU per second; see existing 24-quote GPU dataset
services.quota_notes: Idle worker behavior and cold-start billing important
services.risks: GPU-hour quote alone is not token economics.

services.access_mechanics: Pod hourly rental or serverless worker-second meter; optional persistent volumes.
services.price_or_billing: Per GPU-h; serverless higher rate, cold starts/storage extra
services.quota_notes: GPU availability, quotas, 24/7 idle billing for Pods
services.risks: Self-hosting large MoE weights requires multi-GPU and careful KV cache.

services.access_mechanics: Single/multi-GPU instances for self-hosted model inference/training.
services.price_or_billing: Per-instance/per-hour GPU compute
services.quota_notes: Storage and bandwidth not included in simple price
services.risks: Hardware fit and nontrivial ops burden.

services.access_mechanics: Host-specific on-demand/interruptible compute rental.
services.price_or_billing: live bids only; DO NOT hardcode fixed quote
services.quota_notes: Variable uptime, interruptibility and hardware quality
services.risks: Data sensitivity and host trust before use.

services.access_mechanics: Cloud at ollama.com/v1 API key; local at localhost:11434/v1; model registry differs.
services.price_or_billing: cloud plan/price not verified this pass; local weight serving local power/GPU costs
services.quota_notes: Not all local models available cloud or same tokenization
services.risks: Separate remote key from local no-auth loopback.

services.access_mechanics: Hugging Face routed providers; rate depends provider model/task and plan.
services.price_or_billing: provider-specific billing/credits, check latest
services.quota_notes: Quality/latency of downstream provider variable
services.risks: Routing must preserve actual provider for price/safety.

services.access_mechanics: Hosted models and custom containers, metered GPU or model-specific run fees.
services.price_or_billing: run/compute dependent
services.quota_notes: Container startup and model duration matter
services.risks: Best for specialty batch/media, not guaranteed low-cost chat.

services.access_mechanics: Inference API tied to Workers account, model-specific pricing.
services.price_or_billing: model-dependent on inference units
services.quota_notes: Tool API and context support model dependent
services.risks: Need provider-native billing mapper.

services.access_mechanics: API-hosted accelerated open models / enterprise deployment.
services.price_or_billing: trial/testing credits and enterprise terms change; unpriced here
services.quota_notes: Free trials not reliable constant capacity
services.risks: Do not rely on community free quotas as unlimited.

services.access_mechanics: vLLM, llama.cpp, SGLang expose compatible APIs depending model server.
services.price_or_billing: pay compute/power; not token-priced directly
services.quota_notes: Need GPU capacity and concurrency controls
services.risks: Model license and tool template still gate ability.

shared_ontology.subscriptions_vs_api: Seat coding subscriptions are not fungible with API tokens and need separate credential/usage-policy metadata.
